defaults._doc_grounding: lambda_sup controls supervised loss weight (default 1.0, set to 0 for pure interpretability). lambda_ref, lambda_initmastery, lambda_rate control Representational Grounding strength. theory_guided, calibrate, grounded_init control model behavior.
defaults._doc_regularization: l2 (u_q), lambda_gap (k_s), and lambda_student (v_s) control the parsimony of individualization (L_reg).

seq_len.description: Maximum sequence length for input interactions.

d_model.description: Inner model dimension for embeddings and attention.

n_blocks.description: Number of Transformer blocks (encoder and decoder-like stacks).

d_ff.description: Hidden dimension of the position-wise feed-forward network.

emb_type.description: Type of ID embedding logic (e.g. qid for concept-based).

final_fc_dim.description: Dimension of the final fully connected layers before prediction.

l2.description: Deprecated: legacy L2 weight (superseded by specialized grounding losses).

l2_rasch.description: L2 regularization weight for Rasch-style difficulty parameters.

lambda_ref.description: Supervised loss weight for Bayesian Knowledge Tracing reference predictions.

lambda_initmastery.description: Representational grounding weight for L0 (Initial Mastery) parameters.

lambda_rate.description: Representational grounding weight for T (Learning Rate) parameters.

active_grounding.description: Toggle to enable/disable active grounding using probing dataset targets.

lambda_probe.description: Loss weight for the dedicated linear probing heads.

theory_guided.description: Deprecated: legacy toggle for theory-based logic (superseded by ablation tokens).

size_m.description: Deprecated: memory size for legacy DKT-based models.

graph_type.description: Deprecated: graph structure type for legacy GKT models.

answer_dim.description: Deprecated: legacy dimension for answer-specific embeddings.

epsilon.description: Deprecated: adversarial epsilon for legacy ATKT models.

beta.description: Deprecated: adversarial weight for legacy ATKT models.

lambda_r.description: Deprecated: logic regularization for legacy DKT+ models.

lambda_w1.description: Deprecated: smoothness weight for legacy DKT+ models.

lambda_w2.description: Deprecated: reconstruction weight for legacy DKT+ models.

n_hidden.description: Deprecated: hidden dimension for legacy RNN models.

n_mlp_hidden.description: Deprecated: dimension for legacy MLP layers.

num_en.description: Deprecated: number of encoder layers for legacy SAKT/SAINT.

fusion_type.description: Policy for combining multiple estimates (e.g. late_fusion).

use_wandb.description: Toggle for Weights & Biases experiment tracking.

add_uuid.description: Whether to append UUID to run names for collision avoidance.

ablation.description: Master ablation control (none=all active, all=blackbox baseline).

personalization.description: Whether to enable student-level diagnostic parameters (uids).

kq_same.description: Whether Key and Query use shared projection weights.

separate_qa.description: Whether Question and Answer ids are embedded in separate subspaces.

pretrain_dim.description: Dimension of external pretrained embeddings (if provided).

emb_path.description: Absolute or relative path to pretrained embedding weights.

idkt_baseline.value: Initial version: iDKT = AKT (baseline for interpretability enhancements)
idkt_baseline.rationale: Establish baseline using proven AKT architecture. Future versions will add interpretability features while maintaining performance.
